jobs.title: Head of AI Operations
jobs.description:
Our Mission

We're not your average benefits platform – we're the driving force that uplifts people's lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our Head of AI Operations
, you own Ben's internal applied AI transformation: reinventing how the whole company works, function by function, so the business runs on a new operating system. You'll work directly with the founders, with the backing, budget and authority to make it a reality.

It's a once-in-a-lifetime role. Where most people get one team and a backlog, you get the whole company as your canvas, from customer operations to commercial, finance and people. You find the work that's slow, manual and held together with duct tape, and you rebuild it so it runs itself. Piece by piece, that becomes the way Ben operates.

There's no better place to do it. Ben's whole mission is to make things work at their best, and we already do that in benefits for thousands of companies. Now we're doing it to ourselves, and you're the one who leads it.

Things you'll be working on

Rebuild the company operating system: partner with customer operations, finance, people and commercial to find what's slow, manual and held together with duct tape, and redesign it so it runs seamlessly.
Reinvent how work happens: get hands-on with each function to design and stand up the systems that take on whole workflows end to end, then drive them across the company. A new customer going from signed contract to fully live in days, work that eats weeks today. The customer team looking after twice the number of accounts without anything slipping. The kind of leverage that changes what a company our size can do.
Own the Applied AI strategy: work with the founders to shape where Ben goes next on applied AI, what we change, in what order, and how we know it's working. Engineering owns how AI goes into the product. You own how AI transforms the way we run internally.
Drive adoption and bring people with you: help every function become genuinely AI-native. Raise the bar for how teams work day to day, so the change sticks and the systems actually get used.
Set the standard and prove it works: own the standards, guardrails and quality bar for how Ben adopts AI, and put real evals in place so we know a system works before we trust it with live work, and that it keeps working. Keep us on the right side of compliance as agents start touching customer, people and finance data. This is how what ships gets trusted and used, instead of half-finished pilots piling up.

You'll love this role if you have/are...

High-growth B2B SaaS experience, and evidence you've driven this kind of change: you've operated at pace in a high growth, scaling SaaS business, and you can show how you've shifted the way teams actually work, with the outcomes to back it up.
A strong systems thinker: you think about the bigger picture, and have owned complex problems that cut across different parts of a business.
Deep, practical AI fluency: you use tools like Claude, Claude Code and other AI tooling every day. You've got strong, well-formed views on where they create real value and where they don't, and you can turn that into adoption that sticks across a business.
Exec-level influence in a scaling company: you can carry a room from ICs to the C-suite, challenge leaders well, and turn ambiguity into aligned action.
A bias for getting your hands dirty: you don't lead change from a distance. You get inside how a function really works, redesign it, and work with teams proactively to drive change. You've built things people assumed needed a whole team, and you can show us what and the why.
A force multiplier: You create repeatable systems, lift and develop the people around you, and know when to coach, co-build, push or escalate.

Nice to have(s)

Prompt and context engineering: you have a structured approach to getting the best out of models, and have experience teaching others to do the same.
Have built the guardrails: you've set the bar for what an internal AI system is trusted to do, and put real evals behind it, so you know it works before it goes near live data.

Why join us?

This is one of the most important hires we'll make at Ben, and one of the rare roles where a single person can change how an entire company works.

A canvas most people never get: your remit is the whole company, starting with our biggest and most complex operation, how we deliver for customers.
A real mandate: you work directly with the founders, with the budget, the tools and the backing to take work off entire teams and change how Ben runs.
You'll be at the frontier: the market hasn't even settled on a name for this role yet. Do it well and you write the playbook everyone else copies in a couple of years.
The most impactful work of your career: Ben helps hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries get the benefits and support they need. Make our functions work better and that reaches every one of them.

Our Compensation & Benefits

It’s important to us to practise what we preach when it comes to our benefits. We know what good looks like and we want to provide the best for our team, with a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package. This means you have a choice over the things that are most important to you. You can see a selection below, along with the full offering here.

💰
Competitive base salary
+ equity,
so you own what you build

💳 £100 monthly personal Ben Balance:
for whatever works for you, whether that's Netflix, Spotify, or a really expensive cup of coffee! This allowance will increase by £50 for each year of service until you reach £250

🍔
Weekly lunch provided in office
so you can spend quality time with the team over some tasty food!

🏖 28 days of holidays
a year plus bank holidays, and an option to buy or sell 2 days per year
. Also, your holiday entitlement will increase to 30 days at your 3rd year of service!

🌴 Work-from-abroad scheme,
so you can support your travels, enjoy an extended holiday, or visit loved ones.

🍼 Enhanced parental leave
and workplace nursery scheme
to support with the cost of childcare in a nursery setting

❤️ Comprehensive
Private Medical Insurance

💌 Funded Life Assurance cover
with the option to voluntarily increase - this also includes an annual health check

Diversity and Culture at Ben

We are organically growing a brilliantly diverse, inclusive and respectful bunch of people we are extremely proud of. This should go without saying but all applications are very much welcome. If you need any adjustments to support you with your application, just let us know by emailing jobs@thanksben.com.

Creative Strategist | Paid Social

£60,000–£90,000 + bonus

Kings Cross | Hybrid (3 days on-site)

Our client is an established UK wellness brand built on clinical quality & evidence-led products is expanding its internal performance team. Selling direct-to-consumer & through premium retail, they are bringing paid social creative in-house to scale acquisition across Meta & new channels.

As their new Creative Strategist

Develop insight-driven concept frameworks tailored to key customer segments across Meta & paid social.
Write clear scripts, storyboards & copy for performance ads, partnering directly with freelance designers & editors.
Collaborate with performance marketers to analyse ad data, spot trends, & rapidly iterate on winning assets.
Mine customer reviews, forums & market feedback to discover fresh buying triggers & campaign ideas.

To be considered you can show:

Track record building & briefing high-performing paid social ads (Meta primary).
Strong copywriting & storyboarding skills with a focus on acquisition.
Comfort interpreting ad data to drive creative decisions.
Background in D2C, e-commerce, or trust-led categories
Ability to manage freelance creative talent effectively.

Flexible hybrid setup (3 days on-site).
Discretionary bonus scheme & 3% pension contribution.
25 days holiday + bank holidays + birthday off.
Enhanced parental leave & progressive health policies.

jobs.title: Marketing Director
jobs.description:
Global events business seeks highly accomplished Marketing Director to lead a marketing team and take on a key strategic role developing a portfolio of events.

About the Role

Strategic responsibility for the Division’s marketing performance - including hiring, developing and effectively leading a team of three marketers and editorial who are responsible for creating and executing innovative, international marketing plans. Working in close collaboration with the Marketing Director and Managing Director to reach divisional growth targets, this role has as its focus to:

Responsibilities

Strategic Management of Large-Scale Portfolio of Events
Develop and regularly communicate the Division’s marketing vision, goals and results
Execute one marketing test per month and share
Prepare and execute the marketing plans for approximately 6 events a year, alongside marketing team
Ensure the marketing department are maximising their use of marketing systems to drive efficiencies and results
Measure overall key marketing indicators and report to the group weekly e.g. marketing performance, innovations, inquiry conversion, along with recommendations for improving marketing profitability
Meet regularly with other department heads to ensure marketing is effectively working with other office functions e.g. production, sales, SPEX, customer service; to achieve organisational goals
Proactively identify competitor strategy shifts as well as new marketing methodologies
Work with the other marketing heads as a senior marketing strategy team to generate and assist in best practice and global strategy development
Review and proof marketing copy, websites and marketing collateral
Develop and execute on editorial strategy to create compelling industry led content across portfolio of events, alongside editorial team

Qualifications

5+ years marketing experience, ideally gained within b2b conferences / exhibitions
2+ management experience, with proven ability to coach and motivate staff effectively
Experience with digital marketing (SEO & SEM, social media etc.)
Bachelor level education or equivalent – ideally within marketing or communications

Required Skills

Exceptional interpersonal skills
Excellent written & oral communication skills
Commercial mindset – Experience in managing budgets and ROI for maximum profit gain
Is a creative problem-solver, detail focused and analytically inclined
Ability to work independently under tight deadlines
Self-driven, results-oriented, with a positive outlook

Preferred Skills

Experience in managing budgets and ROI for maximum profit gain

Pay range and compensation package

£65,000 - £80,000 Base + Bonus Hybrid - London

jobs.title: Art Director Creative AI & Image (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du verbindest klassische Art Direction mit den Möglichkeiten generativer AI und möchtest prägende Bildwelten für eine moderne Markenkommunikation entwickeln? Als Art Director Image & AI gestaltest Du visuelle Leitideen, Kampagnenrichtungen und markenbildende Visual-Systeme für HSE. Dabei entwickelst Du starke Bildkonzepte von der ersten Idee über Moodboards und Styleframes bis hin zu AI-gestützten Kampagnenvisuals und arbeitest eng mit Visual Design, Graphic Design, Motion Design und weiteren Content-Teams zusammen.
Das Erwartet Dich

Du entwickelst visuelle Leitideen, Bildwelten und Branding-Elemente, die die HSE-Marke differenzieren und über verschiedene Kampagnen und Content-Formate hinweg konsistent erlebbar machen.
Du konzipierst Key Visuals, Moodboards, Styleframes und Kampagnenrichtungen und übersetzt Markenwerte, Zielgruppenbedürfnisse und Sortimentswelten in starke visuelle Ideen.
Du nutzt generative AI gezielt für Bildentwicklung, Composings, Prototypen und Varianten und entwickelst daraus markenfähige Visuals für digitale und multimediale Anwendungen.
Du baust Prompt-, Style- und Referenzsysteme für wiederkehrende HSE-Bildwelten auf und stellst die gestalterische Qualität und Konsistenz AI-generierter Ergebnisse sicher.
Du entwickelst kanalübergreifende visuelle Konzepte für Shop, App, Newsletter, Social Media, Performance Marketing und Bewegtbild-nahe Formate und schaffst damit die gestalterische Grundlage für die weitere Umsetzung.
Du erstellst schnelle visuelle Prototypen und testbare Varianten und entwickelst Deine Konzepte auf Basis von Feedback, Performance-Impulsen und Marktforschung kontinuierlich weiter.
Du gibst fachliche Impulse im Projektkontext, arbeitest eng mit Graphic Design, Visual Design, Motion Design und Content-Teams zusammen und treibst den Einsatz moderner AI-gestützter Workflows im Designalltag voran.

Das Bringst Du Mit

Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Kommunikationsdesign, Grafikdesign, Visual Design, Art Direction oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung abgeschlossen und bringst mehrere Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Design-, Branding-, Kampagnen- oder Agenturumfeld mit.
Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung visueller Konzepte, Kampagnenmotive, Key Visuals und eigenständiger Bildwelten.
Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Branding, Bildsprache, Komposition, Typografie, Farbigkeit und aktuelle visuelle Trends.
Du beherrschst die Adobe Creative Cloud, insbesondere Photoshop, Illustrator und InDesign, sicher und bringst idealerweise zusätzliche Kenntnisse in Figma oder After Effects mit.
Du hast praktische Erfahrung im professionellen Einsatz generativer AI-Tools wie Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, ChatGPT, Runway oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen.
Du kannst kreative Ideen in markenfähige, konsistente und skalierbare visuelle Systeme übersetzen und unterschiedliche Anforderungen sicher zusammenführen.
Du arbeitest auch bei parallelen Projekten strukturiert, kommunizierst klar und bringst einen hohen gestalterischen Qualitätsanspruch sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und gute bis sehr gute Englischkenntnisse mit.

Hannah Bucher
HR

und weißt, wie man strategische Frameworks für maximales Wachstum entwickelt?

Als strategischer Sparringspartner definierst du die Creative Roadmaps und sicherst die Qualität sowie die strategische Linie von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung ab

Du trägst die Verantwortung für das Erreichen der Performance-KPIs und die langfristige Zufriedenheit deiner Kunden

Du verfügst über min. 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing und hast Expertise in der datengetriebenen Kreation
Du bist Experte im Creative Testing und weißt genau, wie man aus Daten skalierbare Strategien ableitet

Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab

Friend ist Programm: Wir nennen es zuerst, denn das macht uns aus: Kolleg:innen, die sich Freunde nennen, füreinander einstehen und mit denen es Spaß macht zu arbeiten
Volle Flexibilität: Bei uns entscheidest du über Arbeitszeit und Arbeitsort – Hybrid-Work und Homeoffice? Wie es für dich gerade am besten passt!
Zukunftsorientiertes Arbeiten: Wir arbeiten am Puls der Zeit und setzen aktiv auf KI in unserem Leistungsportfolio
JobRad-Leasing: Ob für den Arbeitsweg oder die Wochenendtour – bei uns kannst du dein Wunschrad ganz einfach leasen

"Hell Yes!"?

jobs.title: Brand & Product Development Lead (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du liebst starke Consumer Brands, hast ein außergewöhnliches Gespür für Produkte und Design und gleichzeitig Freude daran, Dinge wirklich umzusetzen?

Dann könnte das hier ziemlich gut passen.

Mit unseren Marken ouchie und 12minutes, haben wir den verstaubten Erste Hilfe Markt in den letzten Monaten und Jahren stark aufgemischt. Das virale Erste Hilfe Set wird von tausenden Familien täglich genutzt und mit dem innovationen Erste Hilfe Kurs für Eltern konnten wir schon zahlreiche Leben retten!

Jetzt möchten wir den nächsten Schritt gehen und sowohl unsere Marken als auch unser Produktportfolio im Familien- und Gesundheitsbereich weiterentwickeln.

Dafür suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende, ambitionierte Person, die gemeinsam mit uns die nächsten Produkte entwickelt, die Marke verantwortet und gleichzeitig die operativen Strukturen dahinter aufbaut.

Aufgaben

Verantwortung für das Produktportfolio und die Marken ouchie und 12minutes

Entwicklung von Produktideen und Kategorien, die nicht nur funktional überzeugen, sondern sich auch stark kommunizieren und vermarkten lassen

Weiterentwicklung bestehender Produkte, Sets, Designs und Verpackungen

Übersetzung von Ideen in konkrete Produktkonzepte und Briefings

Identifikation und Auswahl geeigneter Hersteller und Lieferanten

Koordination von Design, Sampling, Produktentwicklung und Produktion

Unterstützung beim internationalen Rollout unserer Produkte

Koordination von Produktlaunches mit dem Marketing, damit Produkt, Story, Content und Kampagne von Anfang an zusammenspielen

Operative Verantwortung für den Customer Service (1MA), um Kundenfeedback, Trends und Learnings direkt in bestehende und neue Produkte einfließen zu lassen

Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern bei Produktstrategie, Sortiment, Marke und Wachstum

Qualifikation
Uns ist weniger wichtig, dass dein Lebenslauf exakt einem bestimmten Muster entspricht. Viel wichtiger ist für uns die Kombination aus Gespür für Marken und Design, Unternehmergeist und operativer Stärke.

Du passt besonders gut zu uns, wenn du:

ein sehr gutes Gespür für Marken, Produkte, Packaging und Design hast

Consumer Brands liebst und neue Marken, Produkte und Trends früh entdeckst

verstehst, dass ein starkes Consumer Product nicht nur gut funktionieren, sondern auch eine gute Story erzählen und begehrlich sein muss

bei einem neuen Produkt sofort darüber nachdenkst, wie man es noch schöner, einfacher oder besser machen könnte

gleichzeitig strukturiert, analytisch und extrem zuverlässig arbeitest

gerne Verantwortung übernimmst und Themen selbstständig vorantreibst

keine Scheu davor hast, mit Herstellern zu verhandeln, Samples zu organisieren oder Lieferprobleme zu lösen

schnell zwischen kreativem Produktdenken und operativer Umsetzung wechseln kannst

gerne in einem kleinen, unternehmerischen Umfeld arbeitest und was aufbauen möchtest

sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch sprichst

Erfahrung in Consumer Products, Beauty, Lifestyle, FMCG, D2C, Retail, Product Development, Sourcing oder Operations ist ein Plus.

Benefits
Wir suchen eine Unternehmerin im Unternehmen. Jemanden, der selbst tief in den Themen steckt, Produkte entwickelt, mit Marketing Ideen weiterdenkt, Hersteller findet und Dinge von Anfang bis Ende umsetzt.

Gleichzeitig bekommst du sehr viel Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum. Wenn ouchie weiter wächst, besteht sehr viel Potential für dich mit zu wachsen.

Warum wir?

Weil du hier nicht Produkt Nummer 814 in einem großen Unternehmen betreust.

Du kannst mit uns entscheiden:

Welche Produkte bauen wir als Nächstes?

Wie sollen sie aussehen?

Welche Story erzählen wir rund um sie?

Wie bringen wir Produkt und Marketing so zusammen, dass Menschen sie wirklich haben wollen?

Mit welchen Herstellern arbeiten wir?

Und wie bringen wir ouchie von Deutschland in weitere Märkte?

Wenn du Lust hast, eine Consumer Brand nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern wirklich mit aufzubauen, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Für die Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil und beantworte uns kurz drei Fragen:

Welche drei Consumer Brands findest du aktuell besonders stark und warum?

Welches Produkt würdest du für ouchie als Nächstes entwickeln?

Auf welches Produkt oder Projekt, das du bisher umgesetzt hast, bist du besonders stolz?

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

new_jobs.title: Head of AI Operations
new_jobs.description:
Our Mission

We're not your average benefits platform – we're the driving force that uplifts people's lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our Head of AI Operations
, you own Ben's internal applied AI transformation: reinventing how the whole company works, function by function, so the business runs on a new operating system. You'll work directly with the founders, with the backing, budget and authority to make it a reality.

It's a once-in-a-lifetime role. Where most people get one team and a backlog, you get the whole company as your canvas, from customer operations to commercial, finance and people. You find the work that's slow, manual and held together with duct tape, and you rebuild it so it runs itself. Piece by piece, that becomes the way Ben operates.

There's no better place to do it. Ben's whole mission is to make things work at their best, and we already do that in benefits for thousands of companies. Now we're doing it to ourselves, and you're the one who leads it.

Things you'll be working on

Rebuild the company operating system: partner with customer operations, finance, people and commercial to find what's slow, manual and held together with duct tape, and redesign it so it runs seamlessly.
Reinvent how work happens: get hands-on with each function to design and stand up the systems that take on whole workflows end to end, then drive them across the company. A new customer going from signed contract to fully live in days, work that eats weeks today. The customer team looking after twice the number of accounts without anything slipping. The kind of leverage that changes what a company our size can do.
Own the Applied AI strategy: work with the founders to shape where Ben goes next on applied AI, what we change, in what order, and how we know it's working. Engineering owns how AI goes into the product. You own how AI transforms the way we run internally.
Drive adoption and bring people with you: help every function become genuinely AI-native. Raise the bar for how teams work day to day, so the change sticks and the systems actually get used.
Set the standard and prove it works: own the standards, guardrails and quality bar for how Ben adopts AI, and put real evals in place so we know a system works before we trust it with live work, and that it keeps working. Keep us on the right side of compliance as agents start touching customer, people and finance data. This is how what ships gets trusted and used, instead of half-finished pilots piling up.

You'll love this role if you have/are...

High-growth B2B SaaS experience, and evidence you've driven this kind of change: you've operated at pace in a high growth, scaling SaaS business, and you can show how you've shifted the way teams actually work, with the outcomes to back it up.
A strong systems thinker: you think about the bigger picture, and have owned complex problems that cut across different parts of a business.
Deep, practical AI fluency: you use tools like Claude, Claude Code and other AI tooling every day. You've got strong, well-formed views on where they create real value and where they don't, and you can turn that into adoption that sticks across a business.
Exec-level influence in a scaling company: you can carry a room from ICs to the C-suite, challenge leaders well, and turn ambiguity into aligned action.
A bias for getting your hands dirty: you don't lead change from a distance. You get inside how a function really works, redesign it, and work with teams proactively to drive change. You've built things people assumed needed a whole team, and you can show us what and the why.
A force multiplier: You create repeatable systems, lift and develop the people around you, and know when to coach, co-build, push or escalate.

Nice to have(s)

Prompt and context engineering: you have a structured approach to getting the best out of models, and have experience teaching others to do the same.
Have built the guardrails: you've set the bar for what an internal AI system is trusted to do, and put real evals behind it, so you know it works before it goes near live data.

Why join us?

This is one of the most important hires we'll make at Ben, and one of the rare roles where a single person can change how an entire company works.

A canvas most people never get: your remit is the whole company, starting with our biggest and most complex operation, how we deliver for customers.
A real mandate: you work directly with the founders, with the budget, the tools and the backing to take work off entire teams and change how Ben runs.
You'll be at the frontier: the market hasn't even settled on a name for this role yet. Do it well and you write the playbook everyone else copies in a couple of years.
The most impactful work of your career: Ben helps hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries get the benefits and support they need. Make our functions work better and that reaches every one of them.

Our Compensation & Benefits

It’s important to us to practise what we preach when it comes to our benefits. We know what good looks like and we want to provide the best for our team, with a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package. This means you have a choice over the things that are most important to you. You can see a selection below, along with the full offering here.

so you own what you build

for whatever works for you, whether that's Netflix, Spotify, or a really expensive cup of coffee! This allowance will increase by £50 for each year of service until you reach £250

and workplace nursery scheme

Private Medical Insurance

with the option to voluntarily increase - this also includes an annual health check

Diversity and Culture at Ben

We are organically growing a brilliantly diverse, inclusive and respectful bunch of people we are extremely proud of. This should go without saying but all applications are very much welcome.
